title: a ticket's BUILDME crossing is held until every ticket it declares a dependency on is PROVED and every measured BUILDME need carries a DONE mark
intention: inspect_entry gains a lane that reads a ticket's declared dependencies (outcome `after` ticket ids and BUILDME stage_needs) and holds the BUILDME crossing, naming every unmet one, until each ticket is PROVED and each need carries a DONE mark.
why: Measured 2026-11-19: inspect_entry (cairn/tools/base/transitions.py:1045-1093) has six lanes (chart, intent, sorted, open questions, outcome claims, outline check) and none reads a dependency on another ticket. Outcome `after` accepts 12-hex ticket ids and is shape-checked at cast (plan_shape.py) but read by no gate; needs.py (ticket 43905593680a) keeps a per-stage need ledger with measured marks and no entry lane reads it. So 'BUILDME waits on X PROVED' written in a ticket's how text, as for 86cccb7d30f7 (waits on tester exec 21f9628872da and on akiendell pinned), holds nothing: a rule in prose (Law 4).
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy); Law 3 (a need's DONE is an observation with when and how_measured, needs.py); Law 8 (peers lean on a proved ticket, so a build waits for it).
how: A hypothesis, measured by the proof: a seventh lane the_ticket_waits_on_nothing_unproved in inspect_entry reads (a) every ticket-id in the plan's outcome `after`, held unless that ticket's state reads PROVED (an id that resolves to no ticket is held and named), and (b) each need under stage_needs BUILDME, held unless its latest mark (needs.project_needs) is DONE; one finding names every unmet dependency with, for a mark, its age. The build records how a ticket's PROVED is read. Red-first proof under cairn/tools/base/proofs/ over scratch tickets, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.

clauses.claim: a ticket whose outcome `after` names a ticket that is not PROVED is refused at the BUILDME entry, the finding naming that id
the same ticket crosses once the named ticket reads PROVED
a ticket with a stage_needs BUILDME need whose latest mark is not DONE, or that has no mark, is refused naming the need; a DONE mark with when and how_measured lets it cross
an `after` id that resolves to no ticket is refused by name, not passed
a ticket that declares no dependency crosses as before, and one refusal names every unmet dependency at once

decisions.text: D1: inspect_entry gains the lane the_ticket_waits_on_nothing_unproved beside its six, reading outcome `after` ticket ids and the BUILDME stage_needs ledger through needs.project_needs; the build records how a ticket's PROVED is read.
D2: the red-first proof builds scratch tickets and drives inspect_entry, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.

out: cairn/tools/base/needs.py (the ledger and its mark door are unchanged)
recasting 86cccb7d30f7 so it declares its waits (its own re-plan, after this is proved)
whether a mark ever expires (an open edge of 43905593680a)
